description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of the SearchByUrl operation, which is used for online calls to the Taobao Affiliate edition
description_zh: 本文为您介绍SearchByUrl接口的语法及示例，用于向淘宝联盟版在线调用
kebab_example: aliyun imagesearch search-by-url --pic-url https://oss-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/xxxx.jpg --category-id 88888888 --pid mm_xxx_xxx_xxx --user-type 0 --crop true --biz-region 280,486,232,351 --start 0 --num 10 --fields Url,UserType --relation-id 1125526 --api-version 2021-05-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchByUrl

parameters.help_en: The image URL. The URL must start with HTTP or HTTPS
parameters.name: pic_url

parameters.help_en:
The image category. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179184.html.
If you specify a category, the specified category is used. If you do not specify a category, the system predicts the category. You can obtain the predicted category result from the response
parameters.help_zh:
图片类目。具体请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179184.html。
如果设置类目，则以设置的为准；如果不设置类目，则由系统进行类目预测，预测的类目结果可以在Response中获取
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en:
The PID. For more information, see PID (https://help.alimama.com/?spm=a219t.23786078.0.0.290575a55P1LBx#!/search/index?spm=&keyWord=PID&knowledgeId=5625118&categoryId=1000040170).
This field is available when you use SDK V1.1.0 or later
parameters.help_zh:
PID。具体请参考PID (https://help.alimama.com/?spm=a219t.23786078.0.0.290575a55P1LBx#!/search/index?spm=&keyWord=PID&knowledgeId=5625118&categoryId=1000040170)。
使用V1.1.0及以上版本的SDK可用该字段
parameters.name: pid

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform subject identification. Default value: true.
true: The system performs subject identification. We recommend that you use this option.
false: Subject identification is not performed, and the entire image is used for the search
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要进行主体识别。默认true。
为true时，由系统进行主体识别。建议使用此方式。
为false时，则不进行主体识别，以整张图进行搜索
parameters.name: crop

parameters.help_en:
The subject region of the image, in the format of `x1,x2,y1,y2`, where `x1,y1` is the upper-left point and `x2,y2` is the lower-right point.
If you specify Region, the system uses the specified Region for the search regardless of the value of the Crop parameter
parameters.help_zh:
图片的主体区域，格式为`x1,x2,y1,y2`, 其中`x1,y1 `是左上角的点，`x2,y2`是右下角的点。
若用户设置了Region，则不论Crop参数为何值，都将以用户输入Region进行搜索
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The start position of the returned results. Valid values: 0 to 499. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果的起始位置。取值范围：0~499。默认值为0
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en: The number of returned results. Valid values: 1 to 20. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果的数目。取值范围：1~20。默认值为10
parameters.name: num

parameters.help_en: The list of fields to return. Separate multiple fields with commas. The PicUrl, ReservePrice, Title, Url, and ZkFinalPrice fields are always returned by default. You can select from the following values: ItemId, Title, PicUrl, ReservePrice, ZkFinalPrice, UserType, Provcity, Nick, SellerId, Volume, LevelOneCategoryName, CategoryName, CouponTotalCount, CouponRemainCount, CouponStartTime, CouponEndTime, CouponStartFee, CouponAmount, CouponInfo, CommissionRate, CouponShareUrl, Url, ShopTitle
parameters.help_zh: 需要返回的字段list。不同的字段用逗号分隔。默认PicUrl,ReservePrice,Title,Url,ZkFinalPrice字段必返回。可从下面值中选择填写ItemId,Title,PicUrl,ReservePrice,ZkFinalPrice,UserType,Provcity,Nick,SellerId,Volume,LevelOneCategoryName,CategoryName,CouponTotalCount,CouponRemainCount,CouponStartTime,CouponEndTime,CouponStartFee,CouponAmount,CouponInfo,CommissionRate,CouponShareUrl,Url,ShopTitle
parameters.name: fields

parameters.help_en: The channel ID. This parameter is used to distinguish channels in Taobao Affiliate
parameters.help_zh: 渠道ID。用于淘宝联盟中的渠道区分
parameters.name: relation_id
